confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of Cebu price levels, not checked against live menus, rates or listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately grounded; hostel and hotel rates are less certain. Cocktail and wine were set from the beer anchor (about 2.8x and 3.2x) because local bar-price knowledge is weaker. USD figures assume about 58 PHP per USD from general knowledge. The RBA rate came from search summaries that flagged a cache-date mismatch and was not confirmed on the live page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against Metro Manila and other Philippine urban tourist centers from general knowledge; no specific comparison dataset was checked.
